purpose: Guarded, resumable import and placement of the OldCityFacadesV1 detail shells and AUTHORED_INFILL massing into the combined Walkthrough map. Every number a human should review before the run lives here; the per-cell geometry facts live in the generator's facades-manifest.json, which is hash-pinned below.
lastKnownMapSha256Note: Informational only. The map legitimately changes between runs of a resumable job, so a mismatch is recorded in the receipt and never used as a refusal.

source.manifestSha256Note: Pinned so a silently re-authored geometry set cannot be imported under a reviewed spec. Re-running the generator means re-reviewing and updating this hash.
source.objAdapter: Canonical vertices are UE cm; every OBJ is written with Y reflected and triangle winding reversed (create_sanctuary_doors.export adapter, same as the keilim/keruvim/Aron/relief imports). The importer reflects Y back, so the imported StaticMesh must reproduce the manifest canonicalBoundsCm. Old City content sits many tens of metres off origin and is strongly asymmetric in Y, so a failed reflection cannot pass the bounds check.
source.boundsToleranceNote: The OBJ stores centimetres to 2 dp and the engine keeps float32 positions; at world coordinates near 1e5 cm that is a few thousandths of a centimetre, so 1 cm is generous but still catches any reflection, scale or unit error.

namespaceRule: Only this namespace may be written. Re-running the import over an already-imported cell is refused unless -FacadesResume (skip finished cells) or -FacadesPlaceOnly (place actors for assets that already exist) is given. Nothing outside the namespace is created, renamed or deleted.

importSettings.note: The reviewed OBJ adapter path (release_import_doors.spec.json importSettings), with build_nanite ON because these shells are dense decoration seen at every distance, and computed normals because the OBJ carries hard-edged per-face normals and no smoothing groups.
importSettings.naniteFallbackNote: build_nanite on FbxStaticMeshImportData is the primary path. If the readback of static_mesh.nanite_settings.enabled is False the script sets the property directly and reads it back again; a mesh that still reports Nanite off is recorded per-cell, never silently accepted.

materials.rule: First candidate that exists on disk and loads as a MaterialInterface is assigned to EVERY slot (one slot per OBJ, because the OBJs carry a single object and no g groups). Nothing outside this spec's own namespace is created.

createIfMissing.why: The authored infill should read as newer rendered plaster beside the ashlar of the mapped buildings, and it carries no vertex colours, so the parent's vertex-colour term is switched off rather than left reading white.
createIfMissing.verifyByReadback: MaterialEditingLibrary setters return False even on success in UE 5.8; every parameter is read back with get_material_instance_*_parameter_value and any mismatch fails the run.

facades.why: The shells are decoration standing 6 cm proud of boxes that already collide; giving them collision would only add narrow ledges a walker could catch on.

infill.why: Authored infill is new solid massing with no simple primitives, so the render mesh is the collision. Complex-as-simple keeps the walker out of the buildings without generating convex hulls for 1500 plans.

placement.why: Every vertex is already world centimetres in the level's own frame; the alignment was baked once by the original export and must never be applied twice.

resume.why: About 3.4 M triangles across 190 meshes is more than a 16 GB machine wants to import, build Nanite for and save in one editor lifetime. Groups are balanced by triangle count by the generator; each run checkpoints, saves, reopens and writes its own receipt, and -FacadesResume picks up the cells that are not finished.

verification.compareRule: Numeric location/rotation/scale fields and AABB corners only; str(Transform) is never compared (it contains memory addresses).
verification.staticBoundsToleranceNote: The strong Y-reflection / scale test is the 1 cm source.boundsToleranceCm check on the StaticMesh AABB itself. This looser value only guards the actor's component bounds after reopen, which UE derives from the mesh bounds and may pad.
notes: requireTriangleMatch disabled 2026-09-08: with build_nanite on, StaticMesh.get_num_triangles(0) returns the Nanite FALLBACK mesh count (about 11 percent here), not the source triangle count. Bounds round-trip and the source OBJ hash remain the acceptance checks; the fallback count is recorded per cell.

limitations: Import and placement are geometric only. No visual, lighting, walking, packaged or cook acceptance is established by this script.

Every facade detail and every infill building is authored massing in the style of the modern Old City, not survey, not photogrammetry and not a claim about any particular building. Infill is tagged AUTHORED_INFILL on the actor and in the receipt.
The detail shells carry no vertex colours, so M_Context_Building's vertex-colour term reads white on them and its per-building hash tint is uniform within a batch.
The OBJs carry placeholder planar UVs only; the context materials are triplanar and do not read them, and no lightmap UVs are generated.
Nanite is requested at import and verified by readback. A Nanite build failure on a particular cell is recorded, not hidden.
Actor count rises by up to 190. That is deliberate batching by 100 m cell; it is not a per-building actor explosion.
